step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows a lightweight PCI compliance setup. Users interact through a WAF (Imperva/AWS WAF concept), which routes requests to backend Applications (1, 2, 3), a third-party Payment Processor (PP), and a primary CloudFront distribution. CloudFront fronts primary and secondary S3 buckets holding static JS/CSS assets for iFrames. Access logs from both S3 buckets are consolidated into a central S3 log bucket, which triggers SNS notifications upon changes. AWS Config monitors overall configuration compliance.

graph.name: HMH Lightweight PCI Compliance Architecture
graph.notes: HMH uses an iFrame-based architecture with S3, CloudFront, WAF, SNS, and AWS Config to achieve lightweight PCI compliance.
